name: maestro
description: Tests the Android app on a phone or emulator with Maestro and reports the result with screenshots from that run.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed project roots (absolute paths, comma or newline separated)
allowed_roots.description: Folders that projectDir and flowPath must be inside; with none, every project path is refused

android_sdk.title: Android SDK folder (default ~/Library/Android/sdk)
android_sdk.description: adb and emulator are taken from here; default $ANDROID_HOME, $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, else ~/Library/Android/sdk

maestro_path.title: maestro executable (default ~/.maestro/bin/maestro)
maestro_path.description: Absolute path of the maestro CLI

java_home.title: JAVA_HOME for Gradle and Maestro (default: $JAVA_HOME, else Android Studio's bundled JBR)
java_home.description: Absolute JDK folder; overrides $JAVA_HOME for the child tools

flow_timeout_sec.title: Flow run timeout in seconds (default 300)
flow_timeout_sec.description: Whole seconds, 10 to 7200; raising it does not raise the run_flow call timeout below

build_timeout_sec.title: Build timeout in seconds (default 1200)
build_timeout_sec.description: Whole seconds, 10 to 7200; raising it does not raise the build_and_install call timeout below

accounts.title: Test accounts
accounts.description: Account book for login flows; choose the same book as for test-accounts

zh.description: 用 Maestro 在手机或模拟器上测试安卓应用，给出结果和这次运行的截图。
